premises.text: Personal computing interfaces should be tailored to individuals rather than one design for billions of users
premises.evidence_span: personal computing interfaces. tailored to the individual as opposed to a single solution needing to appease two billion users

premises.text: Lumiere enhances and extends the user's existing operating system rather than replacing it
premises.evidence_span: not a replacement for any sort of operating system, rather to embrace, extend, and enhance the system of choice

premises.text: Clean, user-sortable workspaces replace confusing icon streams so users know where windows and taskbar items go
premises.evidence_span: we have a clean delineation of these spaces so you can understand and sort them yourself just by pulling them around

value.text: Light up Windows with interfaces tailored to how each person works
value.evidence_span: a way to light up your windows, Lumiere
